{{Quote|You refuse to see the truth. I don't have to defeat you&mdash;just slow you down. You've lost.''"<br />"''We will meet again at the Emperor's side, my love.|Hareth, to the Knight, and Krannus|<ref name="Anarchy" />}}
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Hareth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The lover of [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]], a fellow Imperial officer, Hareth was also a member of Krannus' [[Krannus's death cult|death cult]] that worshiped the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. During the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire, Hareth [[Mission to Belsavis (Emperor's ritual crisis)|accompanied]] Krannus to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] so that the cult could destroy the world and thereby achieve the Emperor's goals, and she gladly sacrificed herself to stall the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] so that Krannus could complete their mission.
